## generate PI pairs

USing [M+H]+ feature as anchor, assign labels only to the neibouger feature (e.g. 5s, 10s), assign 1 when both found peak matching in to library and also with annotation. label 0 means negative or unsure in semi-supervised learning. 
```{r}

#pairs_for_ml_PA14 <- generate_PI_pairs(annotate_peaks_PA14_result_df, rt_threshold = 5)

pairs_for_ml_PA14 <- generate_PI_pairs(annotate_peaks_PA14_result_df, rt_threshold = 10, ppm_tolerance = 20)


```

```{r}
head(pairs_for_ml_PA14[which(pairs_for_ml_PA14$label %in% 1),],70)
```

## RT similarity
```{r}


rt_sim_obj <- calRTSimilarity(feature_table = result_PA14_FT_filtered,
                        feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_PA14,
                        , method = "gaussian")


rt_sim_res <- rt_similarity(rt_sim_obj)

head(rt_sim_res)

rt_distance_res <- rt_distance(rt_sim_obj)

head(rt_distance_res)


```
```{r}
rt_sim_res[rt_sim_res$feature_1 == "FT0430" & rt_sim_res$feature_2 == "FT0380", ]
```




## EIC similarity 
based on pre calculate feature pair with labels, we calcualte the pairwise feature EIC similarity

```{r}
# step 1:  Create the object
eicData_obj <- new("EICData",
           features = result_PA14_FT_filtered,
           eic_data = result_PA14[[4]])

# step 2: Process EICs using Rcpp
eic_obj <- feature_EIC_process(eicData_obj, nrows = nrow(result_PA14_FT_filtered), ncols = 24)

```


```{r}
# step 3: calculate pairwise EIC similarity

eic_result <- EIC_cor_mat_pairs(
  feature_EIC_combined_result = eic_obj@parsed_EIC,
  feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_PA14,
  rt_EIC_thr = 2.0,
  method = "pearson"
)

```

```{r}
eic_result[eic_result$feature_1 == "FT0430" & eic_result$feature_2 == "FT0380", ]
```




## sample intensity correlation

```{r}
PA14_corintensity <- CorIntensityPair(feature_table = result_PA14_FT_filtered, feature_pairs = pairs_for_ml_PA14,intensity_cols = 18:41)
```



```{r}
head(PA14_corintensity)


PA14_corintensity[PA14_corintensity$feature_1 == "FT0430" & PA14_corintensity$feature_2 == "FT0380", ]

```


## Merge into one




```{r}
library(dplyr)


merged_input <- pairs_for_ml_PA14 %>%
  left_join(rt_sim_res, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%

  left_join(eic_result, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  left_join(PA14_corintensity, by = c("feature_1", "feature_2")) %>%
  
  mutate(
    rt_similarity = replace_na(rt_similarity, 0),
    cor_value = replace_na(cor_value, 0) ,
    EIC_similarity = replace_na(EIC_similarity, 0)
  )

head(merged_input,30)


```



```{r}
write.csv(merged_input,"merged_input_PA14_label_Merge.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
